subject: Ledger stratum: payment channels, VAT flow & cost center splits
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed-health.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Novamed AP <finance@novamed-health.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:04:00 +02:00
Subject: Request: Split invoices to country entities + VAT handling for Q2 deployment

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the performance benchmarks. As we scope commercial ops, AP needs a clear invoicing approach: Novamed has three legal entities that pay into separate cost centers (IT-EU, Clinical-EU, Research-EU). For our accounting, invoices must be split so each entity gets a discrete invoice line (or invoice) with the correct VAT treatment applied per entity.

Specifically:
- Can Redwood issue either (a) a single consolidated invoice with three entity-specific invoice attachments, or (b) three separate invoices referencing the same master SOW? AP prefers separate PDF invoices if possible.
- We need the VAT rate applied by the entity's country and the VAT registration number visible for our reclaim purposes.
- Payment routing: IT-EU pays from our Zurich account, Clinical-EU from NL, Research-EU from BE. Can you surface remit instructions per invoice so our treasury automation can route payments?

Attached is the SOW and our VAT matrix. Please confirm what you need from us (billing contacts, legal entity names, tax IDs, PO numbers) and an estimated timeline to produce a sample split invoice for sign-off. Also confirm whether Redwood can accept a single payment that gets allocated across the three invoices or if separate payments are required.

Best,
Elena
Finance Operations Manager
Novamed Health

Attachments:
- Novamed_SOW_Q2.pdf (application/pdf)
- tax_table_eu_vat_rates.csv (text/csv)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed-health.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 17:12:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Request: Split invoices to country entities + VAT handling for Q2 deployment

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear brief and the files. Looping in Marissa (Billing) and Ben (account lead) so we can align ops & commercial.

Quick answers up front:
- We can produce either a single invoice with appended entity-specific invoice PDFs, or emit three distinct invoices referencing the same master SOW. For AP automation reliability we usually recommend separate invoice PDFs per legal entity.
- VAT will be applied per entity jurisdiction and we will display the VAT registration numbers you provide. For cross-border reverse charge lines we can flag the line item and include the invoice annotation for reclaim.
- Remit instructions: we can embed per-invoice bank details and payment reference fields. We also support a single incoming payment to a Redwood clearing account followed by an internal allocation when authorized by the customer, but that requires an Ops SLA and a reconciliation cadence (suggested: weekly).

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa to draft a suggested invoice split template (sample PDF) and a ledger mapping CSV mapping your entities -> Redwood cost center / GL tag.
2) Elena/Novamed to provide official legal entity names, VAT IDs, and preferred remit instruction text for each entity + PO numbers if available.
3) Ben to confirm commercial terms if we need to enable single-payment clearing / allocation.

Marissa — can you take point on the sample invoice/ledger mapping? I put Novamed's files in our shared drive (link below).

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/novamed/billing-matrix

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed-health.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:30:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Request: Split invoices to country entities + VAT handling for Q2 deployment

Hi all — attached is the sample split-invoice pack and a proposed ledger mapping. Summary of the approach: 

1) Invoice formatting: three PDFs produced (one per Novamed legal entity) with a shared master SOW reference. Each PDF includes line-level VAT rates and the VAT registration number at the header.
2) Ledger mapping: we will tag each invoice to a Redwood cost center so your accounting team can consume a single reconciliation CSV that includes invoice_id, entity_name, cost_center, GL_account, VAT_amount, net_amount, gross_amount.
3) Payment routing options:
   - Option A (preferred): Novamed issues three separate payments to the bank details on each invoice. This is the cleanest for EBICS/SWIFT automation.
   - Option B: Novamed sends one consolidated payment to our clearing account; Novamed provides written authorization for Redwood to internally allocate according to the attached allocation CSV. Note: Option B requires a 3-5 business day reconciliation SLA and a monthly statement of allocations.

4) Tax treatment: For reverse-charge scenarios, we will mark the invoice line as 'RC' and include the explanatory note required for EU reclaim. For intra-company reselling, we will need a supplier declaration.

Please find attachments:
- split_invoices_sample.zip (contains three sample PDFs)
- novamed_ledger_mapping_template.csv

Elena — can you confirm entity legal names exactly as they appear on tax registration and the preferred option (A or B)? Also, do you anticipate a master PO per month or per-entity POs? That affects how we populate the invoice_reference field.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- split_invoices_sample.zip (application/zip)
- novamed_ledger_mapping_template.csv (text/csv)

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:22:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Request: Split invoices to country entities + VAT handling for Q2 deployment

Hi Marissa / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the samples. Novamed confirms the following: 

Legal names and VAT IDs:
- Novamed IT-EU GmbH, DE123456789
- Novamed Clinical NL BV, NL987654321B01
- Novamed Research BE NV, BE0424242424

Payment approach: we will go with Option A for month 1 (separate payments) to validate the flows and then evaluate Option B (single payment allocation) on month 2.

PO expectations: we will issue per-entity POs for now. Treasury will kick off test payments next week. Please ensure the invoice PDFs include the bank BIC/IBAN and a single-line payment ref that contains the invoice_id + our PO number.

Also note: our procurement needs the invoice to explicitly state the VAT handling for each line ("Standard VAT 19% — Germany", "Reverse charge — NL", etc.) for audit. The sample PDFs looked good but please add that exact wording in the VAT line-note.

Ben — we'll send PO numbers by EOD Friday. Thanks everyone for being responsive.

Best,
Elena
Finance Operations Manager
Novamed Health
